description: A software engineer known for constructing and optimizing complex backend services, data pipelines, and cloud-native applications. Her expertise spans Java Spring Boot, Python Django, and Node.js microservices, complemented by significant experience in React for dynamic frontend development.

Proven track record of delivering robust, scalable solutions in diverse environments, from internal recruitment platforms to multi-tenant SaaS. Her work includes building RESTful and GraphQL APIs, integrating third-party systems, and implementing advanced security measures.

With a strong foundation in cloud platforms like AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, I excel at managing the full software development lifecycle, from system design and database modeling to CI/CD and zero-downtime deployments. Also adept at leveraging data science tools and AI/ML integration to unlock new capabilities and improve user experience.

description: Designed and deployed Java (Spring Boot) services powering candidate intake, role-matching, and client workflow APIs for internal recruitment platform, integrating third-party systems (ATS, email, calendaring) via OAuth 2.0 and REST.
Built React dashboard components for recruiter and account-manager workflows, surfacing candidate pipeline status, requisition health, and placement KPIs with sub-second load times.
Modeled PostgreSQL schemas for candidate, requisition, and placement records, and contributed to Dockerized AWS CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing and reliable production releases.

Designed and deployed Python (Django) and Java (Spring Boot) microservices serving RESTful and GraphQL APIs for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, delivering real-time business analytics to 10+ small business clients.

Built HubSpot and QuickBooks sync pipelines with OAuth 2.0, Pandas-based schema normalization, and unified persistence to PostgreSQL and AWS S3, processing 50K+ daily records across 10+ client configurations.
Enforced platform-wide security via JWT authentication, RBAC, and OAuth 2.0 for third-party integrations, eliminating unauthorized cross-tenant data access across all API surfaces.
Reduced API latency by 35% and database CPU load by 20% by optimizing PostgreSQL query plans, restructuring multi-tenant schemas, and introducing Redis caching on high-frequency endpoints.
Containerized services with Docker, published to AWS ECR, and orchestrated zero-downtime deployments to AWS EKS via Kubernetes and Helm, achieving zero deployment failures over 6 months.
Integrated OpenAI GPT-4 with prompt engineering and context management over live PostgreSQL data, enabling natural language business queries and eliminating manual report generation for end users.

Built React and TypeScript dashboard components consuming GraphQL APIs, surfacing live HubSpot and QuickBooks KPIs including revenue trends, deal pipelines, and expense summaries with sub-second load times.
Delivered Node.js and Java (Spring Boot) microservices for PepsiCo’s One Touch platform, exposing store profile, ticketing, and operational data for 10,000+ US retail locations at 99.9% uptime.

Engineered a configurable ticketing system with automated assignment rules and multi-tier escalation logic, cutting average ticket resolution time by 30% and eliminating manual triage across distributed operations teams.
Implemented Kafka producers and consumers handling 50,000+ daily ticket and store-alert events, guaranteeing at-least-once delivery across 8+ downstream microservices.
Modeled PostgreSQL schemas and MongoDB collections for structured and variable store data, achieving a 40% query performance gain through composite indexing and query plan analysis.
Managed Docker builds, Kubernetes workloads, and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, cutting manual deployment steps by 60% and sustaining continuous delivery across a two-year client engagement.
